tvShow.name: L'amour est dans le pré
tvShow.overview: This is a show that allows farmers looking for a spouse to meet single viewers. At the beginning of the year, profiles of the participants are aired, and then interested viewers write a letter to the farmer. During the summer of that same year, the farmer opens the letters he has received and invites potential partners to a speed-dating event. After that, he chooses two people to invite to his home on the farm, in the hope of finally finding a partner.
